basics.name: Priya Raman
basics.headline: Senior product manager, payments and risk
basics.summary: Product manager with eight years in fintech, most recently running card payments at a Series C issuer. I take messy, regulated problems (chargebacks, fraud rules, failed payments) and turn them into products that cut cost and keep customers. Happiest with a small team and a clear number to move.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager, Card Payments
bullets: Led a squad of seven through a rebuild of disputes handling; chargeback losses fell **38%** in nine months and the process moved from spreadsheets into the product.
Launched real-time spend controls used by **61%** of active customers within a quarter, now the most-cited reason in sales win notes.
Raised authorisation rate from 94.1% to **97.3%** by working with Visa and our processor on retry logic and decline-code handling.

roles.title: Product Manager, Checkout
bullets: Owned checkout and subscriptions; moved recurring payments to a new provider with zero lost subscribers across 140,000 accounts.
Cut failed-payment churn by **22%** with smart retries and a card-update flow, worth about £1.1m a year in kept revenue.

roles.title: Associate Product Manager
bullets: Shipped NHS login for repeat prescriptions, lifting sign-up completion from 41% to 63%.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Built the first carrier-cost model in SQL and Looker, which found £400k a year in duplicate invoices.
